results.title: Salavan United Terminates National Football Player Over ‘Unexcused Absence’ Amid Match-Fixing Allegations
results.content: Salavan United Football Club, based in Salavan in southern Laos, has terminated the contract of Lao national team winger Soukphachan Lueanthala amid match-fixing allegations, citing his “unexcused absences” from training. results.title: Miss Universe Laos 2026 Told to Stop Activities Over Brand Rights
